newsitem.title: SWEDEN: LITHUANIA-SAVINGS BANK MAY BE OFFERED IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SAVINGS BANK MAY BE OFFERED IN 1998.

text.p: Lithuanian Finance Minister Algirdas Shemeta said on Thursday that the large Savings Bank may be slated for privatisation in 1998 but it depended on the success of the sale of two other state-run banks.

"After looking at the results of the sale of the other banks, we will take a decision (on Savings Bank)," Shemeta told Reuters in an interview at a Euromoney conference on capital markets in the Baltics.
"The Agriculture Bank should be sold by the end of the first quarter of 1998, and then we will turn our attention to the Savings Bank," he said.

The sale of the State Commercial and Agriculture Bank is a key plank in the government's programme to speed the provatisation process and reform the banking sector, which was rocked by a severe crisis in late 1995.
